warnings.desc: HEAVY RAINFALL which may lead to FLASH FLOODING is possible about parts of the South West and Lower West districts today. Six-hourly rainfall totals between 30 and 60 mm are expected, with possible localised falls up to 70 mm. Heavy falls are expected to ease about the southwest early this evening. Locations which may be affected include Bunbury, Mandurah, Collie, Harvey, Dwellingup, Pinjarra and Rockingham. 50.8 mm was recorded at Ravenscliffe in the 5 hours to 12:30am.
